mechanism_claims.claim_text: Chol-37(F34-R) has direct membrane-permeabilizing evidence from the propidium iodide uptake assay against the tested bacteria.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports membrane permeability as a tested mechanism; it does not define a single molecular receptor target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Chol-37(F34-R) showed functional antibiofilm inhibition and Gram-negative biofilm eradication activity in source assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm outcomes are functional activity evidence, not a resolved molecular mechanism.
